# SelectMultiple { #anylumino.SelectMultiple }

```python
SelectMultiple(
    options=(),
    value=None,
    index=None,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    rows=5,
)
```

List-box multi-selection control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                    | Default   |
|-------------|----------|------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| options | optional | Selectable values or ``(label, value)`` pairs. | `()` |
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `None` |
| index | optional | Selected option index. | `None` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| rows | optional | Visible row count. | `5` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.SelectMultiple.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
